stance_rationale: Forge package is not admissible as a validation package: M3 mitigation was selected using same-sample realized performance, then reused in the same backtest, while lockbox, Harvey 5-spec, DSR penalty, and cost-model evidence are missing or inconsistent. The package also confirms unresolved covariance condition failure and standalone MDD hard-gate failure.

critical_concerns.description: M3 mitigation is selected from M0/M1/M2/M3 using realized 2010-2026 SR and turnover, then the selected M3 return stream is reused for the same 2005-2026 hybrid backtest. This is ex-post model selection, not a pure-function Forge replay, even though package hashes are unchanged.

The selected standalone BAB M3 mitigation still has MDD -46.10%, breaching the hard MDD <45% gate. The package frames M3 as Hurdle-pass because turnover falls to 493%, but the MDD hard constraint remains failed.
Lockbox validation is not separated. No Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined 3-way metrics, no frozen-weight extension proof, and no lockbox marker audit are present in the WT-D20260508_009 Forge artifacts.
Harvey 5-spec regression is absent: no CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, or FF6 t_NW/alpha evidence exists for this Forge package. DSR penalty is also absent for both candidate and baseline.

The 15bps one-way cost model appears undercharged in net returns: build_bab_returns.R and build_bab_mitigations.R subtract turnover_one_way * 15bps, while the package annualizes turnover as round-trip via *12*2. Under a 15bps one-way mandate, traded-notional cost should be consistent with the round-trip turnover convention.

Forge confirms covariance.parquet is PSD but κ_exact=753.75, far above the cond ≤100 post-shrink requirement. Bounds and psi=0.3 are mitigation claims, not evidence that the RF-R2 numerical-stability gate is passed.

AX-001 v2 realized audit reports bad_normal_ic_ratio_realized=null for all four ratios but still marks crisis_alpha pass. AX-001 v2 requires crisis alpha, Core MDD relief, and bad/normal IC ratio, so the defense claim is incomplete.

Primary alpha_scores.parquet is a single 2026-04-30 snapshot; the valid time-series panel exists only as alpha_scores_timeseries.parquet. Weights.csv has 196 dates, but the required monthly_returns.parquet artifact is missing, leaving RF-F2 packaging/audit risk.

supporting_arguments: 3-package MD5 hashes match the values claimed in forge_package_draft.json.
weights.csv contains 196 as_of_date values, 3028 rows, long-only weights, sum-to-one per date, and no weight above the user hard cap of 0.20.
covariance.parquet recomputation matches Forge/Risk numbers: PSD true, min_eig 0.0001407174, κ_exact 753.7499.
equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png are present under stage_artifacts/WT-D20260508_009/forge/charts.
A/B/C/D hybrid ratios are same-period recomputed over 256 months with a common stated 15bps cost framework, although the DSR and cost-convention issues remain unresolved.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Forge is allowed to choose M3 smoothing ex-post from realized full-history results, or whether this must be returned to Optimizer as a new pre-registered package.
Whether the MDD <45% hard gate is judged on standalone WT_009 BAB-M3 or only on the admitted hybrid portfolio.
Whether transaction costs should be charged on one-way turnover or total traded notional under the 15bps one-way mandate.
Whether AX-008 can proceed without Architect or another independent source after Alpha/Risk/Optimizer critics all issued REJECT earlier in the cycle.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that an ex-post selected M3 smoothing overlay can be treated as a pure-function Optimizer mitigation and then used as the single truth for same-sample Forge validation without lockbox split, DSR penalty, or corrected one-way cost accounting.
rebuttal_required: Re-run Forge with a pre-registered mitigation chosen before performance measurement, or issue a revised Optimizer package where M3 is the actual target schedule.
Provide Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined metrics with frozen-extension evidence and lockbox-marked charts.
Add CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions with t_NW, alpha_monthly, DSR, and candidate-penalty arithmetic for candidate and baseline.
Recompute net returns under a consistent 15bps one-way cost convention and show the SR/MDD/turnover deltas.
Resolve covariance κ_exact >100 via a new risk model or robust optimizer evidence rather than asserting bounds/psi mitigation.
rationalization_red_flags: least intrusive — weights post-process within Optimizer scope
sr_lockbox_daily_harness: N/A (Forge runs monthly schedule; daily lockbox would require WT-S20260504_001 cross-validation)
Hurdle PASS applied to turnover while selected M3 standalone MDD remains -46.10%

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge adds useful realized measurements, but it does not convert prior Alpha/Risk/Optimizer REJECTs into a 2-source PASS. The main added evidence actually strengthens rejection: realized BAB admission monotonically reduces hybrid Sharpe and the validation harness is missing lockbox/DSR/5-spec gates.
